newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Telecel says doubles Q1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Telecel says doubles Q1 profit.

text.p: Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel said that net profit over the first quarter of 1997 was up 101 percent at 3.02 billion escudos compared with the same period last year.
The company gave the following figures for the first quarter: (In billions of escudos)
The company said in a statement that between January and March, the number of clients rose 29,731 to 361,119, up 83.5 percent compared with March 1996.
Average revenue per client fell 11.4 percent to 16,502 escudos at the end of the first quarter, compared with the same period last year.
